name: Dumbbell Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Find a box or bench that is roughly knee height or a few inches lower. (The lower the box is the lower the mobility requirement).
You can either place your toes or the top of your foot on the box. Point your front foot forward or slightly turned outwards and break at the knees and hips simultaneously.
Aim to get your front leg to hit parallel depth (hamstring parallel with the ground) or lower.
The further forward your front foot is, the longer the Range of Motion is at your hips. The further back your front foot is, the longer the ROM at your knees.

name: Dumbbell Glute Bridge
instructions: Lay flat on the ground with both feet planted. Make sure you keep your heels glued to the floor.
Place the dumbbell on your hips. Push your hips toward the ceiling until you feel your glutes contract.
Then return to the floor.

name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold the weight tucked into your upper chest area, keeping your elbows in. Your feet should be slightly wider than shoulder width.
Sink down into the squat, keeping your elbows inside the track of your knees.
Push through your heels while keeping your chest up and return to starting position.

name: Dumbbell Goblet Lateral Lunge
instructions: Engage your core by drawing your belly button towards your spine. This will help to stabilize your body. Hold a dumbbell in a goblet position.
Take a large step to the side with your right foot, planting it firmly on the ground.
As you step, bend your right knee and lower your hips until your right thigh is parallel to the ground. Your left leg should remain straight.
Push through your right heel to return to the starting position. Repeat on the opposite side by stepping out with your left foot.

name: Dumbbell Goblet Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Holding the dumbbell in a goblet squat place your foot on a bench or box.
Break at the hips and knees. Try to go to the point where your hamstring is parallel with the ground. Or until your back knee taps the floor.
Make sure to keep your back flat and your elbows directly under your fists.

name: Dumbbell Somersault Squat
instructions: Start in a deep squat holding a dumbbell between your thighs.
Extend your knees until mostly extended without extending the hips.

name: Dumbbell Step Up Knee Drive
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides and place one foot firmly on platform.
Drive through front heel to step up, keeping torso tall and balanced.
Lift trailing knee high at the top, then step down slowly with control.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Step Up Knee Drive
instructions: Hold one dumbbell at your side and place opposite foot firmly on platform.
Drive through front heel to step up, keeping torso tall and core tight.
Lift trailing knee high at the top, then step down slowly with control.

name: Dumbbell Front Rack Step Up Knee Drive
instructions: Hold dumbbells in front rack position and place one foot on platform.
Drive through front heel to step up, keeping chest tall and core braced.
Lift trailing knee high at the top, then step down slowly with control.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Front Rack Step Up Knee Drive
instructions: Hold one dumbbell in front rack position and place opposite foot on platform.
Drive through front heel to step up while keeping chest tall and core tight.
Lift trailing knee high at the top, then step down slowly with control.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Thruster
instructions: Hold dumbbell at shoulder height with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down, then drive upward, pressing dumbbell overhead in one motion.
Lower dumbbell as you descend into next rep smoothly.

name: Dumbbell Alternating Single Arm Thruster
instructions: Hold two dumbbells at shoulder height, palms facing inward.
Squat down, then drive upward, pressing one dumbbell overhead.
Lower dumbbell as you descend again, alternating arms each rep.

name: Dumbbell Front Rack Stability Ball Wall Squat
instructions: Place a stability ball against a wall at about hip height.
Hold two dumbbells in front rack position.
Break at the hips and knees until you hit parallel or just below, then squat back up.

name: Dumbbell Stability Ball Wall Squat
instructions: Place a stability ball against a wall at about hip height.
Hold two dumbbells in each hand.
Break at the hips and knees until you hit parallel or just below, then squat back up.

name: Stability Ball Goblet Wall Squat
instructions: Place a stability ball against a wall at about hip height.
Hold a dumbbell in a goblet position.
Break at the hips and knees until you hit parallel or just below, then squat back up.

name: Dumbbell Goblet Curtsy Deficit Lunge
instructions: Stand on a platform, dumbbell in goblet squat position, feet hip-width apart.
Step back, lowering knee toward floor, keeping chest upright and core engaged.
Push through front foot, return to start, keeping bar stable throughout.

name: Dumbbell Front Rack Curtsy Deficit Lunge
instructions: Stand on a platform, dumbbells in front rack, feet hip-width apart.
Step back, lowering knee toward floor, keeping chest upright and core engaged.
Push through front foot, return to start, keeping bar stable throughout.

name: Dumbbell Curtsy Deficit Lunge
instructions: Stand on a platform, dumbbells in both hands, feet hip-width apart.
Step back, lowering knee toward floor, keeping chest upright and core engaged.
Push through front foot, return to start, keeping bar stable throughout.

name: Dumbbell Quad Stomp
instructions: Place your front foot on a low box and take a split stance. Put all of your weight on your front foot.
Break at the knees and lower yourself until your calves touch your hamstrings.
Push yourself back to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Deficit Reverse Lunge
instructions: Stand on a platform, dumbbells in both hands, feet hip-width apart.
Step back, lowering knee toward floor, keeping chest upright and core engaged.
Push through front foot, return to start, keeping bar stable throughout.

name: Dumbbell Goblet Deficit Reverse Lunge
instructions: Stand on a platform, dumbbell in a goblet position, feet hip-width apart.
Step back, lowering knee toward floor, keeping chest upright and core engaged.
Push through front foot, return to start.

name: Dumbbell Front Rack Deficit Reverse Lunge
instructions: Stand on a platform, dumbbells in front rack position, feet hip-width apart.
Step back, lowering knee toward floor, keeping chest upright and core engaged.
Push through front foot, return to start

name: Dumbbell Assisted Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Grab a stick of some sort or hold onto something stable (rack, bench).
Grab a box that is knee height or slightly lower.
Hold the stick in your right arm, dumbbell in the other and put your right leg on the box.
Begin your squat by breaking at the knees. Get your knee close to the floor or all the way to the floor. Make sure to keep your chest tall.

name: Dumbbell Alternating Forward Lunge
instructions: Stand tall, holding dumbbells by your sides, feet hip-width apart.
Step forward with one leg, lowering until both knees form 90° angles.
Push through front foot, return to start, and switch legs.

name: Dumbbell Alternating Reverse Lunge
instructions: Hold two dumbbells by your side.
Take a big step backwards with your left leg, lowering your body until your left thigh is parallel to the ground and your right knee is bent at a 90-degree angle.
Push back up and switch legs, alternating each rep.

name: Dumbbell Alternating Lateral Lunge
instructions: Hold one dumbbell with one or both hands, feet hip-width apart.
Step out to one side, bending the knee.
Push off, return to center, then switch sides.

name: Dumbbell Goblet Alternating Curtsy Lunge
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at your chest, feet hip-width apart.
Step one leg diagonally back into a lunge.
Alternate legs, keeping your chest up and core engaged.

name: Dumbbell Swing Lunge
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width. Dumbbells at your side.
Step forward with your right foot and bend both knees to lower your body until your right thigh is parallel to the ground.
Push off your right foot to return to the starting position.
Step back with the same leg until the back knee taps the floor.

name: Dumbbell Kickstand Squat
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, one foot slightly behind. Hold dumbbell in a goblet position.
Lower into a squat, keeping weight on front heel.
Return to standing, engaging glutes and core.

name: Dumbbell Box Squat
instructions: Stand in front of a box or bench with your feet shoulder-width apart with a dumbbell in a goblet position.
Lower your body into a squat position, sitting back onto the box and pausing for a moment before standing back up.
Push through your heels to return to the standing position.

name: Dumbbell Step Up
instructions: Stand in front of a step or bench with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold two dumbbells on your side with a neutral grip.
Step up onto the bench with your right foot, pushing off your foot to raise your body up onto the bench.
Bring your left foot up onto the bench and stand up straight, keeping the barbell at your shoulders.
Step back down with your left foot, followed by your right foot, to return to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Step Up
instructions: Stand in front of a step or bench with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold one dumbbell on your side with a neutral grip.
Step up onto the bench with your right foot, pushing off your foot to raise your body up onto the bench.
Bring your left foot up onto the bench and stand up straight, keeping the barbell at your shoulders.
Step back down with your left foot, followed by your right foot, to return to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Front Rack Step Up
instructions: Stand in front of a step or bench with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold two dumbbells at your shoulders with an overhand grip.
Step up onto the bench with your right foot, pushing off your foot to raise your body up onto the bench.
Bring your left foot up onto the bench and stand up straight, keeping the barbell at your shoulders.
Step back down with your left foot, followed by your right foot, to return to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Front Rack Step Up
instructions: Stand in front of a step or bench with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold one dumbbell on your shoulder with an overhand grip.
Step up onto the bench with your right foot, pushing off your foot to raise your body up onto the bench.
Bring your left foot up onto the bench and stand up straight, keeping the barbell at your shoulders.
Step back down with your left foot, followed by your right foot, to return to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Goblet Step Up
instructions: Begin by standing in front of a sturdy box or bench that is about knee-height, holding a dumbbell with a goblet grip.
Place your right foot on the box and push through the heel to lift your body up and onto the box.
Step back down with your right foot.

name: Dumbbell Side Step Up
instructions: Start by standing with your feet about hip-width apart, with a dumbbell in your hands. Your feet should be slightly pointed outward, and your shoulders should be down and relaxed.
Place a step or box beside you, and step up onto it with one foot. Your other foot should remain on the ground.
Push off your grounded foot, raising your body up onto the step.
Step back down with the same foot, returning to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Goblet Side Step Up
instructions: Begin by standing beside a sturdy box or bench that is about knee-height, holding a dumbbell with a goblet grip.
Place your right foot on the box and push through the heel to lift your body up and onto the box.
Step back down with your right foot.

name: Single Arm Overhead Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and a dumbbell in your right hand, extending it overhead.
Inhale and begin to squat down, keeping the dumbbell overhead and your back straight.
Go down as far as you can while still maintaining control, then exhale and return to standing position, keeping the dumbbell overhead. Repeat for desired reps and then switch to the other arm.

name: Dumbbell Overhead Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and hold two dumbbells overhead with both hands, using an overhand grip.
Begin the squat by bending at the hips and knees, keeping your core tight and the dumbbells balanced overhead.
Lower your body as far as you can while keeping the dumbbells overhead, then push back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, making sure to keep your back straight, chest lifted, and the dumbbells stable overhead throughout the entire movement.

name: Dumbbell Thruster
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Bring the dumbbells to your shoulders, with your palms facing inward and your elbows bent.
From this starting position, dip your knees slightly and then quickly extend them as you press the dumbbells upwards.
As you press the dumbbells upwards, also push your hips forward to help generate additional power.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position, and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Dumbbell Sumo Squat
instructions: Start by standing with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart and holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Place the dumbbells on the ground between your feet.
From this starting position, bend your knees and lower your body down into a squat.
Make sure to keep your core engaged and your back straight throughout the movement.

name: Dumbbell Offset Squat
instructions: Hold a dumbbell over one shoulder.
Initiate the squat by pushing your hips back.
Avoid doing any twisting. Try to keep your shoulders even.

name: Dumbbell Leg Extension
instructions: Place a dumbbell between your feet. Lean back slightly and hold on to the bench.
Extend your knees until you feel your quads contract hard.

name: Dumbbell Heels Up Narrow Goblet Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet on a plate. Your feet should be very close to one another, but not touching.
Begin your squat by pushing your hips back and breaking at the knees. Try to keep your chest tall while squatting.

name: Dumbbell Heels Up Goblet Squat
instructions: Take a half kneeling stance. The dumbbell should start over your knee that is up.
Rotate at the spine and point the dumbbell to the opposing side.

name: Dumbbell Goblet Pulse Squat
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in goblet position.
Squat down to parallel depth and then halfway back up.
Stay in this short range of motion for the duration of the set.

name: Dumbbell Front Rack Squat
instructions: Place two dumbbells on your shoulders and push your elbows upward.
Push your hips back and break at the knees.
Hit parallel depth and then drive through your heels back to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Front Rack Pause Squat
instructions: Place two dumbbells on your shoulders and make sure you force your elbows upward.
Push your hips back and break at the knees.
When you reach parallel (hamstrings parallel with the ground) pause for 1-3 seconds. Then push through your heels back to the starting position.
